method: Current official diocesan, patriarchal, shrine, and service records were used to establish Armenian bodies. Search engines and maps were used only to discover first-party sources. Historic buildings under restoration were not treated as current worship bodies, and no body was inferred from population or an unofficial listing.

candidates.name: Church of the Epiphany in Gyumri
candidates.status: hold until restored for current church use
candidates.reason: The diocesan shrine page names the historic church, but its dedicated official page says that it has remained abandoned for decades and needs restoration. It is not counted among the diocese's active churches.

candidates.name: Church of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker in Amrakits
candidates.local: Храм святителя Николая Чудотворца в селе Амракиц
candidates.status: hold until restoration and current worship are established
candidates.reason: The diocese documents the historic church and a 2026 visit, but its restoration remains the subject of current work and the source does not establish regular worship or inclusion in the active roster.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current diocesan roster names eight active churches. Later official service records establish two further current worship sites. All ten current bodies are published, while two buildings under restoration remain held.
